label: agents-md-manifest.cjs --check fails at HEAD (exit 1, 'the manifest's derived key does not match AGENTS.md', recorded body 865f058927ed 'no longer released'). The committed manifest's section 9 body still carries .hermes/agents/, HERMES_AGENT_PERSONA and the cli-hermes packet while live AGENTS.md routes to .dsh/agents/. agents-md-embed.cjs joins manifest.derived.sections[].body verbatim with no Hermes-to-dsh transform, so a vendored repo regenerating AGENTS.md receives the pre-v4.0.2.0 Hermes doctrine. Closes iteration 6's verbatim-vs-transform question.

v4.0.0.11 says --tool names 'Pi or Hermes'; the code enum is claude|codex|devin|cursor|opencode|pi|dsh and rejects hermes with exit 2 ('unknown tool: hermes'). Live docs under .skilled/commands/doctor/ no longer mention Hermes, so only the frozen changelog line is stale, which caps severity at P2.

The Pi ask-surface source adapter imports '../../.skilled/hooks/shared/hook-flags.mjs', which resolves to .skilled/hooks/.skilled/hooks/... and does not exist (ls -d .skilled/hooks/ask-surface-guard/pi/../../.skilled -> No such file). It resolves only from the shipped .pi/extensions/ copy. The Claude and dsh siblings use the location-relative '../../shared/...' form, so two import conventions coexist in one hook family and one adapter is not importable or testable in place.

The resolver reads the live hook-flags.env (path.join(__dirname,'..','hook-flags.env')), which carries no ASK_SURFACE line; SYSTEM_ASK_SURFACE_DISABLED exists only in hook-flags.env.example. The switch is live, not dead config: the ask-surface guard calls isHookEnabled(core.CONCERN). Because hook-flags.env is gitignored and copied once, every later switch addition silently never reaches an existing install and no release note asks for a re-copy. Closes the reachability question carried since iteration 5.

For any flag key, a value set in the live environment wins over hook-flags.env, including an empty string; the file answers only when the env key is undefined. Verified in hookFlagDecision's resolve closure and in isFlagOn.

v4.0.0.11's eleven-check claim is exactly true: install, hooks, trust, gates, standards, allowlist, worktrees, commit-id, advisory-rules, suppression, ai-tool-hooks. A --tool dsh run returns STATUS=OK checks=11. The 'hook counts only when its script exists' clause is implemented as an existsSync guard before the registered status.

v4.0.0.3's advisor respawn claim verifies clean: SPECKIT_BRIDGE_RESPAWN_DISABLED is read on both launcher gates, documented in .env.example and in daemon-lease-contract.md. No name drift, and the registry had zero prior respawn coverage.
Measurement trap recorded: piping a doctor invocation through tail reported EXIT=0 because that was tail's status; the unpiped run exits 2. Exit status must be read without a pipeline.

reason: All four changes (series-parent packets, Devin rule loading, bundled lockfile patches, removed flags) touch no advisor, hook, relaunch or adapter claim. Marked verified-empty for this cluster.
